name: Smoke: workspace file and git basics

tasks.name: Create a file with exact contents
tasks.prompt: Create a file named greeting.txt in the repository root containing exactly one line with the content: vtcode-eval-smoke-line (no leading or trailing whitespace on the line). Do not create any other files.

tasks.name: Create a nested directory structure
tasks.prompt: Create the directory structure notes/2026/ containing a file journal.md whose only line is the markdown heading: #Journal (written as one word, no space after the hash). Create no other files outside the notes/ directory.

tasks.name: Create a file with exact structured content
tasks.prompt: Create a file named data/config.json (create the data directory as needed) containing exactly one line with this JSON object and nothing else: {"name":"vtcode-eval","count":3}

tasks.name: Stage and commit a change
tasks.prompt: Append a single line reading: eval-committed to the end of NOTES.md (create the file if it does not exist), then commit the change with git using the exact commit message: eval-add-notes (a single token, no spaces). Verify the commit exists with git log before finishing. Do not push.
